Berezuvatka Jewish Cemetery

Jewish Cemetery · Kirovohrad Oblast, Ukraine

Not demolished. This record contains a contradiction worth flagging: it is categorized as demolished, yet the source's demolished field marks it as 'no.' Berezuvatka, established in 1807 as the Jewish agricultural colony of Izrailevka, saw its Jewish population reach 1,387 of 1,490 residents by 1897, supported by a synagogue, chadarim, and, from 1909, a Jewish school. All Jews remaining in the village were shot either in autumn 1941 or July 1942. All that remains of this cemetery, established in the mid-18th century, is a single surviving headstone.
